[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Resolve the committing run's own agent name[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
